subject_uz: Aeroport yoqilg'i ombori 12, 14 va 15-sonli rezervuarlari avtomatlashtirish tizimi komponentlarini almashtirish, nazorat-o'lchov uskunalarini yetkazib berish va SCADA ishlab chiqish

requirements.summary_uz: Har bir rezervuar uchun sath o'lchagich, sath datchiklari, harorat datchigi va ularning o'zgartirgichlarini 3 komplektdan demontaj va montaj qilish.
requirements.summary_en: Dismantle and install level gauges, level sensors, temperature sensors and converters, 3 sets of each.

requirements.summary_uz: Nazorat-o'lchov uskunalari aniq markalar va buyurtma kodlari bilan ko'rsatilgan (Endress+Hauser turidagi uskunalar), muqobil ruxsat etilishi aytilmagan.
requirements.summary_en: Measuring equipment is specified by exact brand lines and order codes; no equivalent is mentioned.
requirements.quote: Levelflex FMP51 mikroimpulsli sath o‘lchagichi (FMP51-BBACCALAA4GGJ+LA), RN42-8L1AU+LA faol to‘sig‘i bilan birga — 3 komplekt.

requirements.summary_uz: 12, 13, 14, 9 va 15-sonli rezervuarlar uchun SCADA dasturiy ta'minotini ishlab chiqish talab etiladi.
requirements.summary_en: SCADA software must be developed for tanks 12, 13, 14, 9 and 15.
requirements.quote: № 12, № 13, № 14, № 9 va № 15 bazaviy rezervuarlar uchun SCADA dasturiy ta’minotini ishlab chiqish.

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi qayta tashkil etish, tugatish, bankrotlik yoki buyurtmachi bilan sud nizosi holatida bo'lmasligi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Participant must not be in reorganisation, liquidation, bankruptcy, or in a court dispute with the customer.
requirements.quote: Qayta tashkil etish, tugatish yoki bankrotlik jarayonida bo‘lgan, shuningdek Buyurtmachi bilan sud yoki arbitraj nizosida bo‘lgan tashkilotlar tanlovda ishtirok etishiga yo‘l qo‘yilmaydi.

requirements.summary_uz: Shtatdagi muhandislar soni va sertifikatlari 8 ballgacha baholanadi (4 va undan ko'p mutaxassis = 8 ball).
requirements.summary_en: Staff engineers and certificates scored up to 8 points (4 or more specialists = 8).
requirements.quote: Shtatda sanoat avtomatlashtirish, KIPiA va dasturlash bo‘yicha tajribaga ega, tegishli oliy texnik ma’lumotga ega mutaxassislar mavjudligi

requirements.summary_uz: Neft-gaz yoki aviatsiya yoqilg'i sohasidagi shartnomalar tajribasi 9 ballgacha baholanadi.
requirements.summary_en: Experience with oil, aviation-fuel or chemical sites is scored up to 9 points.
requirements.quote: Neft-gaz yoki aviatsiya YoQMS (TZK) sohasidagi ixtisoslashgan tajriba: So‘nggi yillar davomida portlash xavfi yuqori bo‘lgan neft bazalari, aviatsiya yoqilg‘isini saqlash rezervuarlari yoki kimyo sanoati obyektlarida

requirements.summary_uz: SCADA arxitekturasi va sinov-sozlash metodikasini taqdim etish 6 ballgacha baholanadi.
requirements.summary_en: SCADA architecture and test methodology description scored up to 6 points.
requirements.quote: SCADA tizimini ishlab chiqish va mavjud infratuzilmaga integratsiya qilish qobiliyati

requirements.summary_uz: Ishlarni ishlab turgan obyektda xavfsiz bajarish loyihasi (PPR) va reja-grafik 6 ballgacha baholanadi.
requirements.summary_en: A work-execution project (PPR) for a live site and schedule is scored up to 6 points.
requirements.quote: Ishlarni ishlab turgan obyektda xavfsiz tashkil etish loyihasi (PPR)

requirements.summary_uz: Foydalanish yo'riqnomasi va xodimlarni o'qitish rejasi 8 ballgacha baholanadi.
requirements.summary_en: An operating manual and staff training plan is scored up to 8 points.
requirements.quote: Ishlar yakunlangach, pudratchi buyurtmachiga boshqaruv tizimidan foydalanish bo‘yicha yo‘riqnomani taqdim etishi va xodimlarni boshqaruv tizimida ishlash bo‘yicha o‘qitishi.

requirements.summary_uz: Ishlar muddati hujjatda 2026-yil sentabr-noyabr deb ko'rsatilgan.
requirements.summary_en: The works period is stated in the document as September to November 2026.

requirements.summary_uz: Barcha ishlar, jumladan olovli va payvandlash ishlari, YoMM xizmati bilan kelishilgan holda bajariladi.
requirements.summary_en: All works including hot work and welding are coordinated with the fuel-complex service.
requirements.quote: Obyekt amaldagi faoliyat yuritayotgan obyekt bo‘lganligi sababli barcha ishlar, shu jumladan olov bilan bog‘liq va payvandlash ishlari YoMM xizmati bilan kelishilgan holda

requirements.summary_uz: Ijro hujjatlari qabul qilishdan 5 kun oldin uch nusxada taqdim etiladi.
requirements.summary_en: As-built documents are due in three copies 5 days before acceptance.
requirements.quote: Ijrochi ishlarni qabul qilish boshlanishidan 5 kun oldin Buyurtmachiga ijro hujjatlarini Buyurtmachi belgilagan tarkibda, amaldagi ShNQ me’yorlariga muvofiq, uch nusxada taqdim etadi.

flags.quote: Liquiphant FTL51B tebranishli maksimal sath datchigi (FTL51B-BKA8ABBAA2CJI1VCJ+JALALD) — 3 komplekt.
flags.explanation_uz: Yetkazib beriladigan 7 ta uskuna aniq marka va buyurtma kodlari bilan ko'rsatilgan (Nivotester, Liquiphant, Levelflex, iTHERM), "yoki ekvivalent" deyilmagan. Bu faqat bitta ishlab chiqaruvchining tarmog'idagi yetkazib beruvchilarni qoldirishi mumkin; lot qiymati 1,4 mlrd so'm. Lot mavjud tizim komponentlarini almashtirishga oid bo'lgani uchun moslik sababi bo'lishi mumkin; shunga qaramay «yoki ekvivalenti» iborasi yo'q.
flags.explanation_en: Seven supplied instruments are specified by exact brand lines and order codes with no 'or equivalent' wording. This may leave only suppliers within one manufacturer's channel; the lot is worth 1.4 billion UZS. The lot replaces components of an existing system, so a compatibility reason is conceivable; still, no 'or equivalent' wording is given.
flags.rewrite_uz: Liquiphant FTL51B yoki unga ekvivalent tebranishli maksimal sath datchigi (texnik parametrlari: ... , portlashdan himoya sinfi: ... ) — 3 komplekt. Ekvivalentning mosligi texnik parametrlar jadvali bilan tasdiqlanadi.
flags.rewrite_en: Liquiphant FTL51B or equivalent vibrating maximum-level sensor (technical parameters: ..., explosion-protection class: ...) - 3 sets. Equivalence is shown by a parameter comparison table.

flags.quote: Neft-gaz yoki aviatsiya YoQMS (TZK) sohasidagi ixtisoslashgan tajriba: So‘nggi yillar davomida portlash xavfi yuqori bo‘lgan neft bazalari, aviatsiya yoqilg‘isini saqlash rezervuarlari yoki kimyo sanoati obyektlarida
flags.explanation_uz: Mezon 4 bo'yicha 9 ball neft-gaz, aviatsiya yoqilg'isi yoki kimyo obyektlaridagi shartnomalarga beriladi. Texnik qismning maksimal bali 37 (8+8+6+9+6), o'tish bali 30; bu mezonda 0 ball olgan ishtirokchi ko'pi bilan 28 ball to'plashi mumkin, ya'ni o'tish balidan past. Portlash xavfli muhitda tajriba ahamiyatli, lekin umumiy portlashdan himoyalangan avtomatlashtirish tajribasi ham qabul qilinishi mumkin.
flags.explanation_en: Criterion 4 gives 9 points only for contracts at oil, aviation-fuel or chemical sites. Maximum technical score is 37 (8+8+6+9+6) with a pass mark of 30, so a bidder scoring 0 here can reach at most 28, below the pass mark. Hazardous-area experience matters, but explosion-protected automation work at other site types could also be accepted.
flags.rewrite_uz: So'nggi 5 yil ichida portlash xavfi bo'lgan obyektlarda (neft-gaz, energetika, kimyo, aviatsiya yoqilg'isi va boshqalar) avtomatlashtirish tizimlarini joriy etish bo'yicha tugallangan shartnomalar soni bo'yicha baholanadi.
flags.rewrite_en: Scored by the number of completed automation contracts in the last 5 years at sites with explosion risk (oil and gas, power, chemical, aviation fuel and similar).

flags.explanation_uz: Texnik topshiriqda ishlar muddati 2026-yil sentabr-noyabr deb ko'rsatilgan, lekin lot 2026-yil 16-noyabrda e'lon qilingan va takliflar 23-noyabrda yopiladi. Muddat o'tib ketgan yoki bir necha kun qolgan bo'lib, e'londagi 365 kunlik muddatga zid. Ishtirokchi qaysi muddatga rioya qilishini bilmaydi.
flags.explanation_en: The specification sets the works period as September to November 2026, yet the lot was published on 16 November 2026 and bids close on 23 November, while the lot header lists 365 days. Bidders cannot tell which period applies.
flags.rewrite_uz: Ishlarni bajarish muddati: shartnoma imzolangan kundan boshlab ... kalendar kun (yoki aniq sana).
flags.rewrite_en: Works period: ... calendar days from the contract signing date (or a specific date).
